concept.hr: SRV zapis, račun računala i sigurni kanal; vraćena snimka prekida kanal
concept.en: SRV lookup, computer account, secure channel; a snapshot revert breaks it

summary.hr: PC07 nalazi DC preko DNS-a, dobiva račun računala i lozinku te gradi sigurni kanal. Snimka vraćena nakon dvije promjene lozinke prekida odnos povjerenja.
summary.en: PC07 finds a DC by DNS, gets a computer account and a password, and builds a secure channel. A snapshot reverted after two password changes breaks the trust.
